newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin to meet security chief outside Moscow.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin to meet security chief outside Moscow.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin, still convalescing from a bout of pneumonia at a country residence near Moscow, will meet security chief Ivan Rybkin there on Monday, the presidential press office said.

A spokesman said Yeltsin had no plans to visit the Kremlin on Monday. The president has held a series of meetings in the secluded Gorky-9 residence, and he has looked stiff and wooden in recent television appearances.

Rybkin is the secretary of the policy-making Russian Security Council, which groups senior ministers and members of both houses of parliament. The press service said his meeting with Yeltsin had started at noon (0900 GMT).
